name: three milestones connect along a dashed timeline
looks: Under a headline about ongoing payoff, three small cards (an early day, a few weeks later, months later) sit in a row, each linked to the next by a short dashed, slightly wavy connector line that draws on, with a one-line caption under each card.
build: annotated-diagram-overlay's leader-line build, used as a timeline connector: each dashed SVG segment draws with strokeDashoffset between two cards, the second card fading in right as its connector completes.
sound: A soft tick as each connector finishes drawing.
prompt: Lay out three small milestone cards in a row spanning a short timescale, each linked to the next by a dashed connector line that draws on before the next card appears, with a one-line caption beneath each. Use it to show a single action compounding into payoff over time.
